name: Lumeax Ashor
keeps: what one world owes another and has not said
does: Carries the chain across at the syndication and brings the other world's back. Signs for what he carried and for nothing else.
reason: "The dose makes the poison" is his, and it is the founding sentence of toxicology.
text: Lumeax ashor of the thin wall, carries between for the 5th tranche, doors 39 to 47. Keeps what one world owes another and has not said. Reads Paracelsus.
